_comment: Guard policy for the coinbase MCP server. Allowlist model = default-deny: only the read/quote/list/preview tools below are exposed and callable; every money-moving tool (orders_create/edit/cancel/close_position, convert_execute, transfer, portfolios_create/edit/delete, set_env) is denied by omission and a new tool stays denied until added here. redactPatterns scrub API keys and balance figures from allowed responses.
